name: rpa-plugin-skill
description: OS-Agent RPA Guard Rails plugin/skill skeleton

scripts.sql:register:example: python -m rpa_plugin_skill --register-sql-name "Medical Alpha" --register-sql-ddl "CREATE TABLE doctors (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100));" --register-sql-url "postgres://alpha"

scripts.lint: python -m ruff check rpa_plugin_skill tests scripts
